text: Before Transformers, sequential networks processed tokens one by one, creating a massive training bottleneck.
Self-attention projects tokens into Query, Key, and Value vectors, computing all-to-all relationships in parallel.
Each block fuses multi-head attention with a feed-forward layer, linked by residual connections to prevent vanishing gradients.
Because full attention scales quadratically, production models use FlashAttention and KV caching to unlock massive context windows.
